name: Honey I Bought the House
overview: Honey I Bought The House is a reality series about property and relationships, in which a first-time house-buying couple is given £15,000 towards their deposit. The catch is that only one of them is allowed to search for and secure the property, without the input of the other, in a house hunt lasting three weeks. When the search is over, will the partner be thrilled with the new property and agree to sign the mortgage papers? Or will the couple risk losing that precious deposit?
